scoring_justification: The checker sandbox cannot re-run the DFT geometry optimisation and single-point energy calculations necessary to recompute dissociation energies from raw artifacts; comparing the agent's reported NLSD energies against the paper's published values with tolerance is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table II of the source paper (doi:10.1557/proc-334-289) reports NLSD Si-H dissociation energy for lateral (l) as 87.92 kcal/mol and internal (i) as 84.63 kcal/mol.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values transcribed directly from the published table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values reported by the paper's authors; they serve as the hidden reference for result-level comparison.

outputs.description: NLSD dissociation energies for lateral and internal Si-H bond cleavage on the Si9H16 cluster. Values are compared to fixed reference energies with a tolerance.

output_contract.notes: Scoring uses exact_match against hidden reference values (the paper's reported NLSD energies). The tolerance absorbs implementation differences between DFT codes and basis sets.
